title: This Is Where Interviews Go Wrong (And How to Fix It)
description:
Most candidates don’t lose interviews because of bad answers; they lose them because the interview never turns into a conversation.

In this video, I break down how to make your interview feel more natural, build a real connection, and stand out to hiring managers by asking better questions, clarifying when needed, and engaging authentically.

If you’re interviewing but not getting offers, this shift can make all the difference.

transcript: The key to landing the job offer is making the interview feel like a conversation. The candidate who builds the best connection with strategy one, ask strategic questions throughout your interview. For example, if you're asked about your strengths, tie them to the role, then ask, "What strength do the most successful employees in this position have?" Strategy two, ask clear brain questions when something isn't clear. The third strategy, asking about the interviewer. This is where you make a human connection that sticks, ensures that you stand out as the top candidate. Don't forget to like, subscribe, and hit that bell.
